llm.summary: This is a localized Chinese teacher-assistant skill that reads one named student's learning records to draft renewal reports, with clear limits and manual sending only.

dimensions.detail: The shared platform guidance discloses a China mainland Chinese K12 context, making the Chinese templates and schema labels coherent with the intended locale rather than hidden language forcing.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and JSON only; no executable install scripts, remote payload retrieval, package installation, or tool-wrapping behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit: ask for the student alias before reading, avoid cross-student scans, check parent-communication consent before parent-visible output, and do not send messages automatically.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can write progressEvidence entries, but it discloses this as its only write path, says reports themselves are not stored, and defers student status changes, deletion, sending, and ledger edits to other teacher-confirmed flows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill handles sensitive minor learning records, but that access is directly tied to its stated renewal-report purpose and is narrowed to one specified student and listed workspace fields.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm this skill is appropriate for a Chinese-language independent-teacher workflow and that your workspace consent fields are maintained accurately, since it reads student learning history and may write confirmed progress evidence.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only renewal scripts are consistent with the disclosed Chinese mainland K12 context and the skill's Chinese teacher-facing purpose.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese hint-ladder shared file is part of the same localized education package and does not add hidden authority or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese schema scope note and labels are aligned with the localized workspace data model and do not materially change security risk.
